bootstrap_unit: Joint 960 scenario clusters, stratified by six source dimensions (160 draws each); all model/condition/method records move together. A contrast uses only available pairs in each sampled cluster.
simultaneous_bands: 95% bootstrap max absolute standardized centered deviation; main profile family=36 cells per method; contrast family=up to36 cells per method/contrast, controls separate; refinement family=12 cells per method/setting. Approximate simultaneous coverage within named family, not whole-paper coverage.
